ios.desc:
Chat with your recording? Yes, really.
Record a meeting, lecture, or consultation — then ask your recording anything. No need to listen all over again.

 How it works
 Record — Capture meetings, lectures, or consultations.

 Transcribe — One tap turns speech into text. Supports 8 languages.

 Ask — Just type your question. AI finds the answer from your recording.

 Key Features
 100% On‑device
The AI lives on your phone. Your recordings never leave it.
No cloud. No upload. No Wi‑Fi needed. Your privacy stays yours.

 8 Languages Supported
Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, German, French, Arabic — transcribe across languages seamlessly.

 Optimized for Professionals
Works great for meetings, medical consultations, and legal conversations. Understands industry terms.

 Ask like you chat
No more replaying hours of audio. Just ask your recording — it answers from the transcribed text.

 Recording Management
All files saved locally. Edit, trim, rename — you're in full control.

 Perfect for
 Professionals — Record meetings, ask "What's the conclusion?" "Who owns what?"

 Students — Record lectures, ask "What were the key points?"

 Doctors & Lawyers — Record consultations, ask "What are the critical details?"

 Journalists & Creators — Record interviews, ask "What were the quotes?"

 Talk to recordings. AI.
 Ready to use? First, we'll download the AI core (~2GB) to your device.
 A Wi-Fi connection is recommended for the best experience.
